issue.title: [VOQ] system neigh was not installed in kernel

failure.body:
#### Description

We observed that a system neigh was not installed in kernel on some remote LC when triaging voq test failure in T2 testing. This was seen with internal build of 202205 image.

Our chassis for T2 testing has 3 LCs: `cmp227-4`, `cmp227-5`, `cmp227-6`. The neigh in question is `<IP>`, which was bgp peer of PortChannel1058 on cmp227-6.
```
admin@cmp227-6:~$ show ip interfaces | grep <IP>
PortChannel1058            <IP>/31        up/up         ARISTA50T1      <IP>
admin@cmp227-6:~$
```
The neighbor was added in chassis_db:
```
admin@cmp227-6:~$ sonic-db-cli CHASSIS_APP_DB hgetall "SYSTEM_NEIGH|cmp227-6|Asic0|PortChannel1058|<IP>"
{'encap_index': '1074790409', 'neigh': '<IPV6>'}
admin@cmp227-6:~$
```
The neighbor was installed in kernel on `cmp227-4`:
```
admin@cmp227-4:~$ sudo ip netns exec asic0 ip neigh show <IP>
<IP> dev Ethernet-IB0 lladdr <IPV6> PERMANENT
admin@cmp227-4:~$ sudo ip netns exec asic0 ip route show <IP>/32
<IP> dev Ethernet-IB0 scope link
admin@cmp227-4:~$
```
But it was not installed on `cmp227-5`:
```
admin@cmp227-5:~$ ip neigh show <IP>
<IP> dev Ethernet-IB0  FAILED
admin@cmp227-5:~$ ip route show <IP>/32
admin@cmp227-5:~$
```

resolution.title: Remove system neigh DEL operation if SET operation succeeds
resolution.description:
**What I did**
Remove system neighbor DEL operation in m_toSync if SET operation for the same neighbor succeeds. This is to avoid mistakenly removing the system neighbor.

**Why I did it**
Fix https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/15266

**How I verified it**
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/15266 was uncovered by https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/voq/test_voq_disrupts.py.  The issue was not seen in the test anymore with the fix.
